research_question: Can a low-turnover long/cash trend-following system produce positive net return and positive net Sharpe after realistic costs on globally diversified ETFs?
rationale: Existing L-1 is real E1 evidence, not an empty project: gross annual arithmetic return +3.6674479855%, gross Sharpe 0.4934695406, net annual arithmetic return -2.7427845464%, net Sharpe -0.3681760727, maximum drawdown -29.6729404515%, and 3,224 executed asset trades over 2007-02-05..2015-12-31.

Existing continuous signed q/vol portfolio therefore shows a cost/turnover failure. CORE-1 replaces neither its locked bytes nor history. It tests a simpler long/cash implementation designed to reduce turnover.

L-2, L-3, and L-4 enhancement execution is prospectively paused while CORE-1 is active. Preserve all statuses, evidence tiers, locked artifacts, and history. B8.9-D commit e76a2ec on its unmerged milestone branch is paused and non-authoritative; it must not be merged or edited in this order.

development_candidates_in_locked_order.signal: For each asset, use daily total-return direction over the prior 60 complete sessions; zero return contributes 0; long iff sum(direction)>0, otherwise cash.
For each asset, use daily total-return direction over the prior 120 complete sessions; zero return contributes 0; long iff sum(direction)>0, otherwise cash.
Long iff the current corporate-action-aware total-return close is strictly above its simple moving average over the current and prior 199 complete sessions; otherwise cash.

universe.rationale: US-listed fractional implementation proxies with global countries and asset classes; do not claim point-in-time opportunity-set generality.

no_trade_band.comparison: target versus drifted pre-trade portfolio weight at an execution opportunity
no_trade_band.opening_and_closing_0_125_sleeves: subject to the same rule and normally pass

timing.decision: Weekly after official close of actual last NYSE session of each ISO week using only available data.
timing.execution: Official close of next actual NYSE session.

primary.etf_expense_ratios: then-current locked ETF expense ratios accrued daily on held notional
primary.cash_yield_limitation: Cash yield is 0 until an approved, timestamp-valid cash series exists.
primary.booking_rule: Book commission, spread-slippage, and sell surcharge only on executed notional changes; accrue ETF expense ratios daily on held notional.

development_eligibility_gates.A: Primary net annual geometric return > 0 and primary net annual Sharpe > 0.
development_eligibility_gates.B: PSR versus annual Sharpe 0 is >= 0.90; report HAC/Newey-West mean-return evidence and DSR for all three trials.
development_eligibility_gates.C: Under 2x execution costs, net annual geometric return > 0 and net annual Sharpe > 0.
development_eligibility_gates.D: Primary maximum drawdown is at least 5 percentage points less severe than the matched benchmark (strategy MDD - benchmark MDD >= 0.05, where both are negative or zero).
development_eligibility_gates.E: Remove the single asset with greatest full-window positive net contribution, hold its sleeve as cash without re-optimization, and primary net annual geometric return remains > 0.
development_eligibility_gates.F: Contribution concentration: largest positive asset share <= 0.50; also report positive-contribution HHI and best-episode concentration.
development_eligibility_gates.G: Fixed subperiods 2007-2009, 2010-2012, 2013-2015: at least 2 of 3 have positive net annual geometric return, and no subperiod is below -5% net annual geometric return. Report the locked GFC diagnostic and prior-only global-state/whipsaw diagnostics, but never manufacture a funded regime claim.
development_eligibility_gates.H: No critical timestamp, corporate-action, survivorship/inception, missingness, or accounting blocker.

selection_rule.discard_first: Discard any candidate failing any A-H gate.
selection_rule.primary: Among eligible candidates, choose the one with highest worst-subperiod net Sharpe.
selection_rule.near_tie: If the top two are within 0.02 annual Sharpe on that criterion, choose lower one-way turnover.
selection_rule.final_tie: If still tied within 1e-12, order is CORE1_DC60, CORE1_DC120, CORE1_SMA200.
selection_rule.claim_limit: Selection is E1 development evidence only and does not open validation or claim an edge.

stop_rule: If no candidate passes every A-H gate, stop CORE-1 after CORE-1E, keep validation sealed, and require an owner/Inspector decision to reformulate or close this ETF trend family. No fourth candidate, parameter rescue, universe/date/cost change, or remediation layering. If one candidate passes, lock that single candidate in a separate future order before any request to open final validation.
claim_ceiling: E0 planning/governance only; no empirical result, validation opening, or edge claim.
exact_next_safe_action: CORE-1E only after Inspector acceptance + user integration.
